{{Quote|Our true host, High Lord Takaris Yur. He is the master of this Temple, in charge of guiding our younglings properly along the path of the dark side.|Darish Vol|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
'''Takaris Yur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[41 ABY]]. He was a [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] on the [[Circle of Lords]], the Tribe's ruling council, and was tasked with [[Master of the Sith Temple|running]] their [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]]. Grand Lord Darish Vol considered him ambitious, but not for himself. Rather, he wanted the best he could get for his students. He spoke little, but was listened to when he did.
